versionNote: 0.1.54 preserves every 0.1.53 renderer feature and quality default, avoids repeated Unity Light hierarchy scans with a lifecycle-pruned positive cache, requires deliberate wrist presentation before reveal and applies hide grace, and publishes full alpha coverage for unclipped light range spheres and spotlight cones without adding a render pass.

sourceLineage.referenceMode: read-only HUD placement and emissive overlay pattern
sourceLineage.packagingReferenceMode: read-only bounded Obfuscar.GlobalTool wrapper and receipt discipline
sourceLineage.lineageNote: FA Keyboard informed camera-relative placement and generated overlay visuals. FAP informs build, obfuscation, and package receipt shape. No source from either repo is copied into the runtime plugin.

deployment.policy: Build and deploy compiled DLLs directly to each VaM root's Custom\Plugins folder. No subfolders.

free.summary: Movable, scalable Free radar that shows every eligible radar atom as the same plain yellow dot.

pro.summary: Operational scene-map radar controls with native VaM plugin UI filters, category colors, rotation axes, light volumes, and filming POV helpers.

lightVolumeVisuals.spotLights: cones showing rotation, range, and spot angle

plannedRelease.note: The first Free testing package is FrameAngelDev.Radar.1.var. Human-facing public release branding remains undecided.
